## ✅ Pre-Submission Checklist

<!-- Check all that apply. -->

- [ ] My code follows the [code style guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md#code-style--standards) (PEP 8, type hints, docstrings)
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally on at least one platform (Linux / Windows)
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for my changes
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`python -m pytest tests/ -v`)
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (README, CHANGELOG, docs/) if needed
- [ ] My changes follow the **SMarTr brand design** (dark blue `#0A1A2F`, cyan `#00D9FF`)
- [ ] I have not introduced any new dependencies without justification
- [ ] I have not modified any build/packaging configuration without discussion
- [ ] My commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] I have squashed or organized my commits logically
